en.s: The Second Battle of Bedriacum, also known as the Second Battle of Cremona, was a decisive engagement fought on 24–25 October AD 69 during the Year of the Four Emperors. Two armies of Roman legions, one supporting the emperor Vitellius and the other supporting his Flavian rival Vespasian, clashed near the village of Bedriacum (modern Calvatone in Italy), about 35 km from Cremona in what is now Lombardy.

zh.t: 贝德里亚库姆第二次战役
zh.s: 贝德里亚库姆第二次战役又称克雷莫纳第二次战役，于公元69年10月24日至25日爆发，是“四帝之年”期间的一场决定性战斗。两支罗马军团在意大利贝德里亚库姆村附近交战，一方支持皇帝维特里乌斯，另一方支持弗拉维王朝的竞争者韦斯帕芗。该地今为卡尔瓦托内，距今伦巴第大区的克雷莫纳约35公里。

en.s: The Battle of the Barges or Day of the Barges (Arabic: يوم الشذا‎‎ Yawm al-Shadhā) was fought on October 24, 869 near Basra. It was one of the first major engagements of the Zanj Rebellion, taking place less than two months after the outbreak of the revolt. The battle was the culmination of several weeks of fighting between the Zanj rebels and local defenders in the villages and canals of southern Iraq. A large army of volunteers from the city of Basra that had set out to quell the Zanj was ambushed and defeated by the insurgents.

zh.s: 驳船战役又称“驳船日”（阿拉伯语：يوم الشذا，Yawm al-Shadhā），于869年10月24日在巴士拉附近爆发。这是赞吉起义早期的一场重要交战，发生在起义爆发不到两个月后。此前数周，赞吉起义军与当地守军已在伊拉克南部的村庄和运河一带持续作战。巴士拉派出一支庞大的志愿军镇压赞吉起义，却遭叛军伏击并被击败。

en.t: After defeating the Mongols at the Battle of Ain Jalut and assassinating the previous Mamluk sultan, Qutuz, Baybars ascends to the Egyptian throne as the fourth sultan of the Mamluk Sultanate
en.s: The Battle of Ain Jalut (Arabic: معركة عين جالوت, romanized: Ma'rakat 'Ayn Jālūt), also spelled Ayn Jalut, was fought between the Bahri Mamluks of Egypt and the Ilkhanate on 3 September 1260 near the spring of Ain Jalut in southeastern Galilee in the Jezreel Valley. It marks the first major halt to Mongolian advances and paused their expansion into Arabia and Europe.

zh.t: 贝巴尔斯继任马穆鲁克苏丹，成为第四任苏丹
zh.s: 艾因贾鲁特之战（阿拉伯语：معركة عين جالوت，罗马化：Ma'rakat 'Ayn Jālūt），也拼作Ayn Jalut，于1260年9月3日在加利利东南部耶斯列谷的艾因贾鲁特泉附近爆发，交战双方是埃及巴赫里马穆鲁克和伊儿汗国。此战首次大规模遏制了蒙古人的扩张，并阻止其继续向阿拉伯地区和欧洲推进。

en.s: Sayf ad-Din Qutuz (Arabic: سيف الدين قطز; died 24 October 1260), also romanized as Kutuz or Kotuz and fully al-Malik al-Muẓaffar Sayf ad-Dīn Quṭuz (الملك المظفر سيف الدين قطز lit. 'The Victorious King, Sword of the Faith Qutuz'), was the Mamluk Sultan of Egypt. He reigned as Sultan for less than a year, from 1259 until his assassination in 1260, but served as the de facto ruler for two decades.

zh.s: 赛义夫·丁·忽秃思（阿拉伯语：سيف الدين قطز；1260年10月24日去世），也译作库图兹或科图兹，全名为马利克·穆扎法尔·赛义夫·丁·忽秃思（الملك المظفر سيف الدين قطز，意为“胜利之王、信仰之剑忽秃思”），是埃及马穆鲁克苏丹。他于1259年至1260年在位，不到一年便遭刺杀；不过，在正式执政前，他已实际掌权二十年。

en.s: The Thiérache campaign, also known as the chevauchée of Edward III of 1339, was the march from Valenciennes, Hainault across Cambrésis, Picardy and Thiérache in northern France by an English army with Flemish, Hainault and Holy Roman Empire allies. It began on 20 September 1339, resulting in the siege of Cambrai and ended with the withdrawal of the English forces on 24 October, 1339, into Brabant.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒂耶拉什战役又称1339年爱德华三世远征，是英格兰军队及其佛兰德、埃诺和神圣罗马帝国盟军从埃诺的瓦朗谢讷出发，穿越康布雷西、皮卡第和法国北部蒂耶拉什地区的一次行军。行动始于1339年9月20日，随后围攻康布雷；英军于1339年10月24日撤入布拉班特，战役至此结束。
zh.n: 此条目采用来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Treaty of Brétigny is ratified, marking the end of the first phase of the Hundred Years' War
en.s: The Treaty of Brétigny was a treaty, drafted on 8 May 1360 and ratified on 24 October 1360, between Kings Edward III of England and John II of France. In retrospect, it is seen as having marked the end of the first phase of the Hundred Years' War (1337–1453). It was signed at Brétigny, a village near Chartres, and was later ratified as the Treaty of Calais on 24 October 1360.

zh.t: 《布雷蒂尼条约》获批准，百年战争第一阶段结束
zh.s: 《布雷蒂尼条约》于1360年5月8日拟定，并于1360年10月24日获批准，由英王爱德华三世和法王约翰二世缔结。后世认为，该条约标志着百年战争（1337—1453年）第一阶段结束。条约在沙特尔附近的布雷蒂尼村签署，后来于1360年10月24日获批准，称为《加莱条约》。

en.s: Battle of Kremmer Levee took place during Uckermark War, on 24 October 1412, on the Kremmer Levee, near the village of Kremmen. It was fought by forces of Pomerania-Stettin against the Margraviate of Brandenburg.

zh.s: 克雷默堤坝战役于1412年10月24日在乌克马克战争期间发生，地点靠近克雷门村。交战双方是波美拉尼亚-什切青公国军队和勃兰登堡侯国军队。

en.s: The siege of Florence took place from 24 October 1529 to 10 August 1530, at the end of the War of the League of Cognac. At the Congress of Bologna, the Medici Pope Clement VII and Emperor Charles V agreed to restore the Medici family in Florence. A large Imperial and Spanish army under Philibert of Châlon, Prince of Orange and Pier Maria III de' Rossi surrounded the city and after a siege of nearly ten months, captured it.

zh.s: 佛罗伦萨围城战于1529年10月24日至1530年8月10日进行，是干邑同盟战争末期的一场围城战。博洛尼亚会议上，出身美第奇家族的教宗克莱孟七世和皇帝查理五世同意恢复美第奇家族对佛罗伦萨的统治。菲利贝尔·德·夏隆（奥兰治亲王）和皮耶尔·玛丽亚三世·德·罗西率领庞大的帝国与西班牙联军包围该城，近十个月后攻占佛罗伦萨。

en.s: The Capture of Porto took place in October 1580 by the Spanish forces commanded by Don Sancho d'Avila during the War of the Portuguese Succession. The city was captured easily by the Spanish troops, thereby finishing off the Prior of Crato's army and its final defeat in Mainland Portugal, thus assuring the personal union of Portugal and Spain for 60 years under the Iberian Union.

zh.s: 1580年10月，葡萄牙王位继承战争期间，唐·桑乔·达维拉率领的西班牙军队攻占波尔图。西班牙军队轻易拿下该城，彻底击败克拉托修道院院长的军队及其在葡萄牙本土的最后一支部队，由此确保葡萄牙与西班牙在伊比利亚联合时期维持共主邦联60年。

en.s: The Siege of Niezijl was a siege of the town of Niezijl that took place between 3 and 24 October 1581 in the Dutch States, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). The Spanish under Colonel Francisco Verdugo laid siege to the place after his victory at the battle of Noordhorn but the siege failed and Verdrugo retreated leaving the English and Dutch under John Norreys and William Louis respectively the victors. Count Rennenberg, Stadtholder of Friesland had betrayed the cities of Groningen, Oldenzaal, Coevorden and Delfzijl to Spanish control and himself became a turncoat.

zh.s: 尼耶泽尔镇围城战于1581年10月3日至24日在尼德兰联省共和国境内进行，属于八十年战争和英西战争（1585—1604年）的一部分。西班牙上校弗朗西斯科·贝尔杜戈在诺德霍恩战役获胜后开始围城，但未能攻下该镇，随后撤退。约翰·诺里斯和威廉·路易率领的英国和荷兰守军获胜。弗里斯兰执政官雷嫩贝格伯爵曾将格罗宁根、奥尔登扎尔、库福尔登和德尔夫宰尔等城市出卖给西班牙，并叛变投敌。

en.s: The Second Spanish Armada also known as the Spanish Armada of 1596 was a naval operation that took place during the Anglo–Spanish War. Another invasion of England or Ireland was attempted in the autumn of 1596 by King Philip II of Spain. In an attempt at revenge for the English sack of Cádiz in 1596, Philip immediately ordered a counter strike in the hope of assisting the Irish rebels in rebellion against the English crown.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙第二舰队又称1596年西班牙舰队，是英西战争期间的一次海军行动。1596年秋，西班牙国王腓力二世再次尝试入侵英格兰或爱尔兰。为报复英军1596年洗劫加的斯，腓力立即下令反击，希望支援反抗英格兰王室的爱尔兰叛军。

en.t: Phelim O’Neill issues the Proclamation of Dungannon
en.s: On October 24, 1641, Phelim O’Neill issued a proclamation at Dungannon explaining the Irish uprising that had begun the previous day. He declared loyalty to King Charles I and claimed royal authority for the rebels’ actions. His claim to hold a royal commission was disputed. Dungannon is now in Northern Ireland.
en.n: The proclamation was issued on October 24, one day after the uprising began.

zh.t: 费利姆·奥尼尔发布《邓甘嫩宣言》
zh.s: 1641年10月24日，费利姆·奥尼尔在邓甘嫩发布宣言，为前一天爆发的爱尔兰起义作出解释。他宣称效忠查理一世，并声称起义军的行动得到了国王授权。不过，他关于持有国王委任状的说法受到质疑。邓甘嫩如今位于北爱尔兰。
zh.n: 宣言于10月24日发布，比起义爆发晚一天。

en.s: The Thirty Years' War, fought primarily in Central Europe between 1618 and 1648, was one of the most destructive conflicts in European history. An estimated 4.5 to 8 million soldiers and civilians died from the effects of battle, famine, or disease, with parts of Germany reporting population declines of more than 50%.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 三十年战争主要在中欧进行，时间为1618年至1648年，是欧洲历史上破坏性最强的冲突之一。据估计，约有450万至800万军民死于战斗、饥荒或疾病；德国部分地区的人口下降超过一半。
zh.n: 此条目采用来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.t: The Peace of Westphalia treaties are signed
en.s: On October 24, 1648, peace treaties between the Holy Roman Emperor, France, Sweden and their allies brought the Thirty Years' War to an end. Negotiations had taken place in Münster and Osnabrück, in what is now Germany. The October settlement was separate from the earlier Dutch–Spanish peace treaty signed that year.
en.n: October 24 is the Gregorian signing date of the imperial treaties with France and Sweden.

zh.s: 1648年10月24日，神圣罗马皇帝与法国、瑞典及各方盟友缔结和平条约，结束了三十年战争。此前，谈判在今德国的明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克两城进行。十月签署的这些条约，与同年较早签订的荷兰—西班牙和约是不同的协议。
zh.n: 皇帝与法国、瑞典缔结条约的公历日期为10月24日。

en.s: The siege of Fredriksodde, also known as the Storming of Fredriksodde (Swedish: Stormningen av Frederiksodde; Danish: Stormen på Frederiksodde) and the conquest of Fredriksodde (Swedish: Erövringen av Fredriksodde), was a successful Swedish siege of the fortress and town of Fredriksodde (modern day Fredericia) in 1657 during the Dano-Swedish War of 1657–1658. The siege and the subsequent capture of the fortress by Swedish forces completed the Swedish conquest of Jutland.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 腓特烈西亚围城战又称腓特烈西亚强攻战（瑞典语：Stormningen av Frederiksodde；丹麦语：Stormen på Frederiksodde）或腓特烈西亚攻占战（瑞典语：Erövringen av Frederiksodde），是瑞典军队于1657年在丹麦—瑞典战争期间围攻腓特烈西亚要塞及城镇并获胜的战役。要塞随后被瑞典军队攻下，瑞典也由此完成对日德兰半岛的征服。腓特烈西亚即今天的腓特烈西亚市。
zh.n: 此条目采用来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Quebec was fought in October 1690 between the colonies of New France and Massachusetts Bay, then ruled by the kingdoms of France and England, respectively. It was the first time Quebec City's defences were tested. Following the capture of Port Royal in Acadia, during King William's War, the New Englanders hoped to seize Quebec City itself, the capital of New France.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 魁北克战役于1690年10月在新法兰西殖民地和马萨诸塞湾殖民地之间进行，当时两地分别由法国王国和英格兰王国统治。这是魁北克市的防御工事首次经受考验。威廉王战争期间，新英格兰人攻占阿卡迪亚的皇家港后，希望进一步夺取新法兰西首府魁北克市。
zh.n: 此条目采用来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Skirmish of Dunfermline was a conflict that took place on 24 October 1715 in Dunfermline, Scotland and was part of the Jacobite rising of 1715. It was fought between the forces of John Campbell, 2nd Duke of Argyll who supported the British-Hanoverian Government against a Jacobite force.

zh.s: 邓弗姆林小规模交战于1715年10月24日在苏格兰邓弗姆林发生，是1715年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。交战双方一方是支持英汉诺威政府的阿盖尔公爵约翰·坎贝尔率领的部队，另一方是詹姆斯党军队。

en.s: The Battle of Basarke, also known as Battle of Basarke and Hujra Shah, was fought on 23 October 1736 between the Sikh forces led by Nawab Kapur Singh and the Mughal forces led by Lakhpat Rai.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴萨尔克之战又称巴萨尔克与胡吉拉沙阿之战，于1736年10月23日爆发，交战双方是卡普尔·辛格纳瓦卜率领的锡克军队和拉赫帕特·拉伊率领的莫卧儿军队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Adyar (also the Battle of Adyar River) took place on 24 October 1746. The battle was between the French East India Company men and forces of Nawab of Arcot, Anwaruddin Khan over the St. George Fort, which was held by the French. It was part of the First Carnatic War between the British and the French.

zh.s: 阿迪亚尔战役于1746年10月24日爆发。战斗围绕法军控制的圣乔治堡进行，交战双方是法国东印度公司士兵和卡纳提克纳瓦布安瓦鲁丁·汗的部队。此次战役属于英法之间的第一次卡纳提克战争。

en.s: The action of 24 October 1793 was fought during the War of the First Coalition. While cruising in the Northern Bay of Biscay, the Royal Navy frigate HMS Thames, under Captain James Cotes, encountered the much larger French frigate Uranie, under Captain Jean-François Tartu. The ships engaged, with each suffering severe damage until they separated after nearly four hours of continual combat.

zh.s: 1793年10月24日，第一次反法同盟战争期间发生了一场海战。英国皇家海军“泰晤士”号护卫舰在比斯开湾北部巡航时，遇到规模大得多的法国“乌拉妮”号护卫舰。前者由詹姆斯·科茨上尉指挥，后者由让-弗朗索瓦·塔尔图上尉指挥。两舰交战，均遭受重创，持续近四小时后才分开。

en.s: At the Battle of Schliengen (24 October 1796), both the French Army of the Rhine and Moselle under the command of Jean-Victor Moreau and the Austrian army under the command of Archduke Charles of Austria claimed victories. The village of Schliengen lies in the present-day Kreis Lörrach close to the border of present-day Baden-Württemberg (Germany), the Haut-Rhin (France), and the Canton of Basel-Stadt (Switzerland). During the French Revolutionary Wars, Schliengen was a strategically important location for the armies of both Republican France and Habsburg Austria. Control of the area gave either combatant access to southwestern German states and important Rhine river crossings.

zh.s: 1796年10月24日施利恩根战役中，让-维克托·莫罗指挥的法国莱茵和摩泽尔军团与查理大公指挥的奥地利军队都宣称获胜。施利恩根村位于今德国洛拉赫县，靠近今德国巴登-符腾堡州、法国上莱茵省和瑞士巴塞尔城市州的交界处。法国大革命战争期间，施利恩根对共和法国和哈布斯堡奥地利军队都具有重要战略意义。控制该地区的一方即可进入德国西南各邦，并掌握莱茵河上的重要渡口。

en.s: The Second Battle of Novi or Battle of Bosco (24 October 1799) saw a Republican French corps under General of Division Laurent Gouvion Saint-Cyr face a division of Habsburg Austrian soldiers led by Feldmarschall-Leutnant Andreas Karaczay. For several hours, the Austrians defended themselves valiantly, relying on their superior cavalry and artillery. By the end of the day, the French and allied Poles routed the Austrians from their positions in this War of the Second Coalition action.

zh.s: 诺维第二次战役又称博斯科战役，于1799年10月24日爆发。洛朗·古维翁-圣西尔师长率领的法国共和军与安德烈亚斯·卡拉恰伊中将指挥的哈布斯堡奥地利军队交战。奥军凭借骑兵和炮兵优势英勇防守数小时。当天结束时，法军和波兰盟军击溃奥军，迫使其撤离阵地。这场战斗属于第二次反法同盟战争。

en.s: The fall of Berlin took place on 24 October 1806 when the Prussian capital of Berlin was captured by French forces in the aftermath of the Battle of Jena–Auerstedt. Berlin fell 15 days after the beginning of the war. The French Emperor Napoleon entered the city after three days without a fight, from which he issued his Berlin Decree implementing his Continental System.

zh.s: 1806年10月24日，法国军队在耶拿—奥尔施泰特战役后攻占普鲁士首都柏林。战争爆发15天后，柏林陷落。法国皇帝拿破仑在三天后未遇抵抗便进入该城，并从那里颁布《柏林敕令》，实施大陆体系。

en.s: The Battle of Maloyaroslavets took place on 24 October 1812 as part of the French invasion of Russia. Armies were evenly matched in the battle and suffered similar casualties, with a marginal edge going to the Franco-Italian army. It was Mikhail Kutuzov's decisive battle to force Napoleon to retreat northwest over Mozhaisk to Smolensk on the devastated route of his advance with a higher probability of starvation.

zh.t: 马洛亚罗斯拉韦茨战役
zh.s: 马洛亚罗斯拉韦茨战役于1812年10月24日在法国入侵俄国期间爆发。交战双方军力相当，伤亡相近，法意联军略占优势。米哈伊尔·库图佐夫在此战中迫使拿破仑向西北撤退，经莫扎伊斯克前往斯摩棱斯克，沿途是其此前进军时已遭破坏的路线，饥荒风险更高。

en.s: The Treaty of Gulistan (also spelled Golestan: Russian: Гюлистанский договор, romanized: Gyulistanskiy dogovor; Persian: عهدنامه گلستان, romanized: Ahdnāme-ye Golestān) was a peace treaty concluded between the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran on 24 October 1813 in the village of Gulistan (now in the Goranboy District of Azerbaijan) as a result of the first full-scale Russo-Persian War (1804 to 1813).

zh.s: 《古利斯坦条约》（亦作《戈列斯坦条约》；俄语：Гюлистанский договор，转写：Gyulistanskiy dogovor；波斯语：عهدنامه گلستان，转写：Ahdnāme-ye Golestān）是俄罗斯帝国与卡扎尔伊朗于1813年10月24日在古利斯坦村（今阿塞拜疆戈兰博伊区）签署的和平条约，结束了1804至1813年的第一次全面俄波战争。

en.s: The 1816 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on October 24, 1816, in order to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Mahlon Dickerson was re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1816年10月24日举行州长选举。现任民主共和党州长马伦·迪克森未经竞争，由新泽西州议会选出并连任。

en.s: The Treaty of Whampoa (simplified Chinese: 黄埔条约; traditional Chinese: 黃埔條約; pinyin: Huángpǔ Tiáoyuē; Cantonese Yale: Wòhngbou Tìuhyeuk) was an unequal treaty between the Kingdom of France and the Qing dynasty of China, which was signed by Qiying and Théodore de Lagrené on October 24, 1844, aboard the warship L’Archimède.

zh.s: 《黄埔条约》是法国王国与清朝之间的一项不平等条约，由耆英和拉萼尼于1844年10月24日在“阿基米德”号军舰上签署。

en.s: The 1856 Victorian colonial election was held from 23 September to 24 October 1856 to elect the first Parliament of Victoria. All 60 seats in 37 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though eight seats were uncontested. The eligibility to vote at the 1856 Victorian election was subject to a property qualification. The voting was carried out by secret ballot.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1856年9月23日至10月24日，维多利亚殖民地举行选举，选出首届维多利亚议会。立法议会37个选区的60个席位全部改选，其中8个席位没有竞争者。此次选举设有财产资格限制，并采用无记名投票。

en.s: On October 24, 1857, Nathaniel Creswick and William Prest founded Sheffield Football Club in Sheffield, England. Its inaugural meeting took place at Parkfield House. The club later developed the Sheffield Rules and is recognized as the oldest surviving independent football club.
en.n: The club held its inaugural meeting on October 24, 1857.

zh.t: 谢菲尔德足球俱乐部成立
zh.s: 1857年10月24日，纳撒尼尔·克雷斯威克和威廉·普雷斯特在英格兰谢菲尔德创立了谢菲尔德足球俱乐部，首次会议在帕克菲尔德庄园举行。俱乐部后来制定了“谢菲尔德规则”，被公认为现存历史最悠久的独立足球俱乐部。
zh.n: 俱乐部于1857年10月24日举行首次会议。

en.t: Britain and Qing China sign the Convention of Peking
en.s: On October 24, 1860, Lord Elgin and Prince Gong signed the British–Chinese Convention of Peking in Beijing. The agreement confirmed earlier treaty terms and ceded the part of the Kowloon Peninsula south of what became Boundary Street to Britain. It was one of several separate conventions concluded with foreign powers at the end of the Second Opium War.
en.n: October 24 is the date of the British–Chinese convention; the French and Russian agreements were separate instruments.

zh.t: 清政府与英国签署《北京条约》
zh.s: 1860年10月24日，额尔金伯爵与恭亲王奕䜣在北京签署中英《北京条约》。条约确认了此前的条约内容，并把九龙半岛后来界限街以南的部分割让给英国。这是第二次鸦片战争结束时，清政府与外国分别签订的几份条约之一。
zh.n: 10月24日签署的是中英条约，中法、中俄条约是另外的文件。

en.s: The siege of Sélestat was a siege, extending from 20 to 24 October 1870, of the French Alsatian fortress of Sélestat, during the Franco-Prussian War. After artillery bombardment by the Germans, the siege ended when the French army surrendered, mainly because the French garrison was demoralized. The Germans suffered only minor losses, while this victory brought them many spoils.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞莱斯塔围城战发生于1870年10月20日至24日，是普法战争期间普鲁士军队围攻法国阿尔萨斯要塞塞莱斯塔的战役。德军炮击后，法军投降，围城战结束，主要原因是法国守军士气低落。德军仅有轻微损失，并从这场胜利中获得大量战利品。
zh.n: 此条目采用来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Chinese massacre of 1871 was a racially motivated riot which occurred on October 24, 1871 in Los Angeles, California, when a mob of around 500 white men entered Chinatown to attack, rob, and murder Chinese residents of the city. The massacre took place on Calle de los Negros (Street of the Negroes), also referred to as "Nigger Alley", which later became part of Los Angeles Street. An estimated 17 to 20 Chinese immigrants were systematically tortured and then hanged by the mob, making the event the largest mass lynching in American history.

zh.s: 1871年10月24日，美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶发生带有种族主义动机的暴乱。约500名白人暴徒闯入唐人街，袭击、抢劫并杀害当地华人居民。大屠杀发生在黑人街（Calle de los Negros），该街也曾被称作带有种族歧视意味的“Nigger Alley”，后来并入洛杉矶街。暴徒对估计17至20名华人移民施以酷刑，随后将他们吊死，使该事件成为美国历史上规模最大的集体私刑。

en.s: The Shinpūren rebellion (神風連の乱, Shinpūren no ran / Jinpūren no ran) was an uprising against the Meiji government of Japan that occurred in Kumamoto on 24 October 1876. The Keishintō (敬神党), an extremist Shinto organization of former samurai of the Kumamoto Domain, were extremely opposed to the Westernization of Japan and loss of their class privileges after the Meiji Restoration.

zh.s: 神风连之乱（日语：神風連の乱，Shinpūren no ran／Jinpūren no ran）是反对日本明治政府的一场起义，于1876年10月24日在熊本发生。敬神党是由熊本藩前武士组成的激进神道组织，强烈反对日本西化，也反对明治维新后丧失原有阶级特权。

en.s: The Battle of Gorni Dubnik took place during the Russo-Turkish War on 24 October 1877. In an effort to reduce the fortress of Pleven quicker, Russian forces began targeting garrisons along the Ottoman supply and communications route. A significant garrison had been reduced at the Battle of Lovcha in September. General Joseph Vladimirovich Gourko was called up from the Shipka Pass area to deal with more of the garrisons protecting Pleven.

zh.s: 戈尔尼杜布尼克战役于1877年10月24日在俄土战争期间爆发。为尽快攻下普列文要塞，俄军开始打击奥斯曼军队补给和交通线路上的驻军。此前，俄军于9月在洛夫恰战役中攻下一个重要驻军据点。约瑟夫·弗拉基米罗维奇·古尔科将军从希普卡山口地区被调来，负责打击更多保护普列文的驻军。

en.s: The 1877 New South Wales colonial election was held between 24 October and 12 November 1877. This election was for all of the 73 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 53 single-member constituencies, six 2-member constituencies and two 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system. Suffrage was limited to adult male British subjects, resident in New South Wales.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1877年10月24日至11月12日，新南威尔士举行殖民地选举，改选立法议会全部73个席位。选举在53个单议席选区、6个双议席选区和2个四议席选区举行，均采用简单多数制。选民资格限于居住在新南威尔士的成年男性英国臣民。

en.t: Normanton incident: As the British merchant vessel Normanton sinks off the coast of Japan, her European officers appear to commandeer the ship's lifeboats for themselves, leaving her Asian crew and passengers to die and conjuring significant political outrage in Japan
en.s: The Normanton incident (ノルマントン号事件, Norumanton-gō jiken) was a series of events surrounding the sinking of the British merchantman Normanton of the coast of Japan's Wakayama Prefecture on 24 October 1886. Normanton, which had a mixed crew of Europeans and Asians along with 25 Japanese passengers onboard, was sailing from Yokohama to Kobe when it ran aground in bad weather and began sinking.

zh.s: 诺曼顿号事件是围绕英国商船“诺曼顿”号于1886年10月24日在日本和歌山县海岸附近沉没而发生的一系列事件。船上有欧洲和亚洲船员以及25名日本乘客，事发时正从横滨驶往神户。恶劣天气导致船只搁浅并开始下沉。

en.s: The Battle of Jiuliancheng (九連城之戰) was a land battle of the First Sino-Japanese War between the forces of Meiji Japan and Qing China. It is sometimes referred to as the Battle of the Yalu River (鴨緑江作戦, Ōryokuko Saksuken), thus creating confusion with the previous naval conflict of the same name of 17 September, and the subsequent naval and ground battles of the Russo-Japanese War, with the same name and occurring at much the same location.

zh.s: 九连城之战（九連城之戰）是甲午战争期间明治日本与清朝军队之间的一场陆战。此战有时也称鸭绿江作战（鴨緑江作戦，Ōryūko Sakusen），容易与此前9月17日同名的海战，以及后来日俄战争中在大致同一地点发生的同名海战和陆战混淆。

en.s: The Peruvian Civil War of 1894–1895 was an internal conflict in Peru that lasted from October 1894 to March 1895, and was sparked by the election of Andrés Avelino Cáceres to the presidency of Peru, which was opposed by Nicolás de Piérola and his armed forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 秘鲁内战发生于1894年10月至1895年3月，是秘鲁国内冲突。安德烈斯·阿韦利诺·卡塞雷斯当选秘鲁总统引发了战争；尼古拉斯·德·皮埃罗拉及其武装力量反对这一结果。

en.s: The Battle of Magdalena River (Spanish: Batalla del río Magdalena) was a battle of the Thousand Days' War. It took place on 24 October 1899, ending in a victory for the conservatives.

zh.s: 马格达莱纳河战役（西班牙语：Batalla del río Magdalena）是千日战争期间的一场战斗，于1899年10月24日爆发，以保守派获胜告终。

en.t: U.S. Government announces plans to buy Danish West Indies for $7 million
en.s: The Danish West Indies (Danish: Dansk Vestindien), also known as the Danish Virgin Islands (Danish: Danske Jomfruøer) or the Danish Antilles, were a Danish colony in the Caribbean, consisting of the islands of Saint Thomas with 83 square kilometres (32 sq mi), Saint John (Danish: St. Jan) with 49 square kilometres (19 sq mi), and Saint Croix with 220 square kilometres (85 sq mi).

zh.t: 美国政府宣布计划以700万美元购买丹麦属西印度群岛
zh.s: 丹麦属西印度群岛（丹麦语：Dansk Vestindien）又称丹麦维尔京群岛（丹麦语：Danske Jomfruøer）或丹麦安的列斯群岛，是丹麦在加勒比海的殖民地，包括圣托马斯岛，面积83平方公里（32平方英里）；圣约翰岛（丹麦语：St. Jan），面积49平方公里（19平方英里）；以及圣克罗伊岛，面积220平方公里（85平方英里）。

en.s: The 1902 eruption of Santa María was one of the largest eruptions of the 20th century, measuring a six on the volcanic explosivity index. The main eruption began on 24 October 1902 and lasted no more than 20 hours. Prior to its catastrophic eruption, Santa María had no record of an eruption. The eruption killed between 5,000 and 8,700 people.

zh.s: 1902年圣玛丽亚火山喷发是20世纪规模最大的喷发之一，火山爆发指数达6级。主喷发于1902年10月24日开始，持续不超过20小时。在这次灾难性喷发之前，没有圣玛丽亚火山曾经喷发的记录。喷发造成5,000至8,700人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Kumanovo (Serbian: Кумановска битка / Kumanovska bitka, Turkish: Kumanova Muharebesi), on 23–24 October 1912, was a major battle of the First Balkan War. It was an important Serbian victory over the Ottoman army in the Kosovo Vilayet, shortly after the outbreak of the war. After this defeat, the Ottoman army abandoned the major part of the region, suffering heavy losses in manpower (mostly due to desertions) and in war materiel.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 库马诺沃战役（塞尔维亚语：Кумановска битка / Kumanovska bitka；土耳其语：Kumanova Muharebesi）于1912年10月23日至24日举行，是第一次巴尔干战争中的一场重要战役。塞尔维亚军队在战争爆发后不久，于科索沃省战胜奥斯曼军队。这次战败后，奥斯曼军队放弃该地区大部分地方，人员和军事物资损失惨重，其中人员损失大多来自逃兵。

en.s: The Battle of Kirk Kilisse or Battle of Kirklareli or Battle of Lozengrad was part of the First Balkan War between the armies of Bulgaria and the Ottoman Empire. It took place on 22 - 24 October 1912. Bulgarian forces of the First and Third Armies defeated the Ottoman Eastern Army and captured Lozengrad. The victory forced the Ottoman forces to retreat toward the Lüleburgaz–Bunarhisar line and opened much of northern Thrace to the Bulgarians.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 柯尔克拉雷利战役又称柯尔克拉雷利战役、洛曾格勒战役，是第一次巴尔干战争期间保加利亚与奥斯曼帝国军队之间的战斗。战役于1912年10月22日至24日进行。保加利亚第一、第三集团军击败奥斯曼东部军团，并攻占洛曾格勒。此役迫使奥斯曼军队撤向吕莱布尔加兹—布纳尔希萨尔一线，也使保加利亚军队得以进入色雷斯北部大片地区。

en.s: The 1915 Copa de Competencia Jockey Club final was the football match that decided the champion of the 9th. edition of this National cup of Argentina. In the match, played at the Porteño Stadium in Palermo on 24 October 1915, Porteño defeated Racing 2–1 to win their first Copa de Competencia trophy.

zh.s: 1915年赛马会竞技杯决赛决定了第9届阿根廷国内杯赛冠军。比赛于1915年10月24日在巴勒莫的波特尼奥体育场举行，波特尼奥队以2比1击败竞赛队，首次赢得赛马会竞技杯。

en.s: The 1915 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the twenty-eighth All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Ballygeehan representing Laois defeated Redmonds from Cork in the final to record Laois's first All-Ireland title.

zh.t: 1915年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1915年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛是第28届全爱尔兰决赛，也是全爱尔兰曲棍球锦标赛的收官战。这项赛事由爱尔兰各郡的顶级球队参赛。代表劳伊斯郡的巴利吉汉队在决赛中击败科克郡的雷德蒙兹队，为劳伊斯郡首次赢得全爱尔兰冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Caporetto (also known as the Twelfth Battle of the Isonzo, the Battle of Kobarid or the Battle of Karfreit) took place on the Isonzo front of World War I. The battle was fought between the Kingdom of Italy and the Central Powers and took place from 24 October to 19 November 1917, near the town of Kobarid (now in north-western Slovenia, then part of the Austrian Littoral), and near the river Isonzo.
en.n: World War I: Italy suffers a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Caporetto on the Austro-Italian front.

zh.s: 卡波雷托战役又称伊松佐河第十二次战役、科巴里德战役或卡尔弗赖特战役，是第一次世界大战伊松佐河战线上的一场战役。交战双方为意大利王国和同盟国，战役于1917年10月24日至11月19日在科巴里德镇（今属斯洛文尼亚西北部，当时属于奥地利滨海地区）及伊松佐河附近进行。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：意大利在奥意战线上遭遇惨败，在卡波雷托战役中失利。

en.s: The Battle of Vittorio Veneto was fought from 24 October to 4 November 1918 near Vittorio Veneto on the Italian Front during World War I. After having defeated Austro-Hungarian troops during the Second Battle of the Piave River and recognizing the dire internal situation of Austria-Hungary caused by the course of the war and the blockade of the Adriatic at sea, the Royal Italian Army launched a major offensive: the Italian victory marked the end of the war on the Italian Front and the dissolution of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, contributing to the end of the First World War just one week later.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 维托里奥·威尼托战役于1918年10月24日至11月4日在第一次世界大战意大利战线上、维托里奥·威尼托附近进行。意大利王家军队此前在第二次皮亚韦河战役中击败奥匈军队，并意识到奥匈帝国因战争和亚得里亚海封锁而陷入严重内忧，于是发动大规模攻势。意大利获胜，标志着意大利战线上的战争结束、奥匈帝国解体，并促成一周后第一次世界大战结束。

en.s: The 1920 Svenska Mästerskapet final was played on 24 October 1920 between the eleventh-time finalists Djurgårdens IF and the first-time finalists IK Sleipner. The match decided the winner of 1920 Svenska Mästerskapet, the football cup to determine the Swedish champions. Djurgårdens IF won their fourth title with a 1–0 victory at Stockholm Olympic Stadium in Stockholm.

zh.s: 1920年瑞典锦标赛决赛于1920年10月24日举行，由第11次闯入决赛的佐加顿斯IF对阵首次闯入决赛的IK斯莱普纳，争夺决定瑞典冠军归属的瑞典锦标赛冠军。佐加顿斯IF在斯德哥尔摩奥林匹克体育场以1比0获胜，夺得队史第四个冠军。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 24 October 1921. This was the first election to use proportional representation, rather than the previous two round system. The result was a victory for the Conservative Party-Free-minded Liberal Party alliance, which won 57 of the 150 seats in the Storting.

zh.s: 挪威于1921年10月24日举行议会选举。这是首次采用比例代表制的选举，此前实行两轮投票制。保守党—自由思想党联盟获胜，在议会150席中赢得57席。

en.s: The Battle of Budaörs was a minor armed clash on 23–24 October 1921 between the governmental forces of the Kingdom of Hungary and the loyalist forces of Charles IV of Hungary, who tried to reclaim the throne of Hungary after his resignation in 1918.

en.s: The Hamburg Uprising (German: Hamburger Aufstand) was a communist insurrection that occurred in Hamburg in Weimar Germany on 23 October 1923. A militant section of the Hamburg Communist Party of Germany launched an uprising as part of the so-called German October. Rebels stormed 24 police stations, 17 in Hamburg and seven in Schleswig-Holstein Province in Prussia, and established barricades around the city.

en.s: The 1926 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 39th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1926 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 24 October 1926 between Cork and Kilkenny. The Leinster champions lost to their Munster opponents on a score line of 4–6 to 2–0.

zh.t: 1926年全爱尔兰高级投掷锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1926年全爱尔兰高级投掷锦标赛决赛是第39届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1926年全爱尔兰高级投掷锦标赛的收官赛。这项盖尔式投掷赛事由爱尔兰各郡的顶级球队参加。科克队与基尔肯尼队于1926年10月24日在都柏林克罗克公园交手。伦斯特冠军以0比2负于芒斯特对手，比分为2比4对4比6。

en.t: Everton beats Blackburn Rovers to win the FA Charity Shield
en.s: On October 24, 1928, Everton beat Blackburn Rovers 2–1 at Old Trafford in Manchester to win the FA Charity Shield. Everton entered as the reigning league champions and Blackburn as the FA Cup holders. It was the fifteenth edition of the competition.
en.n: The Charity Shield match took place on October 24, 1928.

zh.t: 埃弗顿击败布莱克本，赢得英格兰慈善盾
zh.s: 1928年10月24日，埃弗顿在曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场以2比1击败布莱克本流浪者，赢得英格兰慈善盾。埃弗顿以上一赛季联赛冠军身份参赛，布莱克本则是足总杯冠军。这是第15届慈善盾比赛。
zh.n: 这场慈善盾比赛于1928年10月24日举行。

en.t: On "Black Thursday", the New York Stock Exchange lost 11 percent of its value at the opening bell on very heavy trading, marking the beginning of the Great Depression
en.s: The Wall Street crash of 1929, also known as the Great Crash, was a major stock market crash in the United States which began in October 1929 with a sharp decline in prices on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). It triggered a rapid erosion of confidence in the U.S. banking system and marked what would later cascade into the worldwide Great Depression that lasted until the United States entered into World War II on December 8, 1941, making it the most devastating crash in the country's history.

zh.t: “黑色星期四”：纽约证券交易所开盘时股价大跌11%，大萧条由此开始
zh.s: 1929年华尔街股灾又称“大崩盘”，是美国股市的一次重大崩盘，始于1929年10月纽约证券交易所股价急剧下跌。股灾迅速削弱了公众对美国银行体系的信心，并引发后来席卷全球的大萧条。大萧条一直持续到美国于1941年12月8日参战，成为美国历史上破坏最严重的一次股灾。

en.s: The Revolution of 1930 (Portuguese: Revolução de 1930), also known as the 1930 coup d'état was an armed movement led by the states of Minas Gerais, Paraíba and Rio Grande do Sul, culminating in a coup. Known as the Coup of 1930, the revolution ousted President Washington Luís on October 24, 1930, prevented the inauguration of President-elect Júlio Prestes, and ended the Old Republic. In 1929, leaders of São Paulo broke the alliance with the mineiros (i.e. people from Minas Gerais state), known as the "coffee with milk policy" ("política do café-com-leite" in Portuguese), and indicated the paulista Júlio Prestes as a candidate for the presidency.

zh.s: 1930年革命（葡萄牙语：Revolução de 1930）又称1930年政变，是由米纳斯吉拉斯州、帕拉伊巴州和南里奥格兰德州领导的一场武装运动，最终演变为政变。1930年10月24日，革命推翻了总统华盛顿·路易斯，阻止候任总统儒利奥·普雷斯特斯就职，并结束旧共和国。1929年，圣保罗州领导人打破与米纳斯吉拉斯州人士的联盟，即“咖啡牛奶政策”（葡萄牙语：política do café-com-leite），并提名圣保罗州的儒利奥·普雷斯特斯竞选总统。

en.t: The George Washington Bridge is dedicated
en.s: On October 24, 1931, the George Washington Bridge was dedicated at a ceremony marking the new Hudson River crossing between Manhattan and Fort Lee, New Jersey. The bridge opened to vehicle traffic at 5 a.m. the following day. The ceremony and the start of regular traffic were separate milestones.
en.n: The dedication was October 24; vehicle traffic began October 25.

zh.t: 乔治·华盛顿大桥举行落成典礼
zh.s: 1931年10月24日，连接曼哈顿与新泽西州李堡的乔治·华盛顿大桥举行落成典礼，为这条横跨哈德逊河的新通道揭幕。大桥于次日凌晨5时开放车辆通行，典礼和正式通车分别在两天举行。
zh.n: 落成典礼在10月24日举行，车辆通行从10月25日开始。

en.s: The Siege of Rogatica was a joint attack of Partisan and Chetnik rebel forces on Rogatica held by the Independent State of Croatia (modern-day in Bosnia and Herzegovina) which lasted between 13 and 24 October 1941.

en.s: The Battle of Finschhafen was part of the Huon Peninsula campaign during World War II and was fought between Australian and Japanese forces. The fighting took place between 22 September and 24 October 1943 following the landing at Scarlet Beach, which was followed by a two-pronged advance on Finschhafen as the Australian 20th Infantry Brigade advanced on the town from the north, while the 22nd Infantry Battalion drove from the south, having advanced from the landing beaches east of Lae. After the capture of Finschhafen, the Japanese forces in the area withdrew towards Sattelberg where they sought to hold the Australians before launching a counter-offensive, which subsequently threatened the landing beach.

zh.s: 芬施港战役是第二次世界大战休恩半岛战役的一部分，交战双方是澳大利亚和日本军队。战斗于1943年9月22日至10月24日进行，起于澳军在斯卡莱特海滩登陆之后；澳大利亚第20步兵旅从北面向芬施港推进，第22步兵营则从南面推进，此前他们从莱城以东的登陆海滩出发。芬施港被攻占后，当地日军撤往萨特尔贝格，试图阻挡澳军并发动反攻，随后威胁到登陆海滩。

en.s: The Invasion of Val d'Aran, known under the code name Operación Reconquista de España ("Operation Reconquest of Spain"), was a military operation launched in October 1944 by the Unión Nacional Española (antifrancoist) (UNE). In October 1944, with the Spanish Civil War over and the Axis powers in World War II in retreat, guerrilla fighters loyal to the Republic tried to conquer Val d'Aran in Catalonia and establish a provisional Republican government presided over by Juan Negrín in order to later overthrow the dictatorship of Francisco Franco.

en.t: World War II: The USS Tang (SS-306) sank in the Formosa Strait after being struck by its own torpedo, with 78 of its crew lost
en.s: USS Tang (hull number SS-306) was a Balao-class submarine of World War II, the first ship of the United States Navy to bear the name Tang. She was built and launched in 1943, serving until being sunk by her own torpedo off China in the Taiwan Strait on 24 October 1944. In her short career in the Pacific War, Tang sank 33 ships totalling 116,454 tons.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：“坦号”潜艇遭自身鱼雷击中，在台湾海峡沉没，78名艇员遇难
zh.s: “坦”号（舷号SS-306）是美国海军巴劳级潜艇，也是美国海军第一艘以“坦”为名的舰艇。该艇于1943年建造并下水，参加太平洋战争，最终于1944年10月24日在中国近海的台湾海峡遭自身鱼雷击中而沉没。服役时间虽短，但“坦”号击沉了33艘船只，总吨位达116,454吨。

en.t: World War II: The USS Shark (SS-314) was lost with all 87 hands in the Bashi Straits after torpedoing the Japanese freighter Arisan Maru
en.s: USS Shark (SS-314), a Balao-class submarine, was the sixth ship of the United States Navy to be named for the shark, a large marine predator. Construction began in 1943 and commissioning occurred in 1944. Following shakedown, Shark was deployed to the Pacific, where she attacked ships and rescued downed airmen. Shark was sunk on its third patrol by a Japanese destroyer on 24 October 1944.

zh.t: 第二次世界大战：“鲨鱼”号潜艇被日军驱逐舰击沉，87名艇员全部遇难
zh.s: “鲨鱼”号（SS-314）是巴劳级潜艇，也是美国海军第六艘以鲨鱼命名的舰艇。该艇于1943年开始建造，1944年服役。完成试航后，“鲨鱼”号被派往太平洋，曾袭击船只并营救被击落的飞行员。该艇在第三次巡逻期间，于1944年10月24日被日本驱逐舰击沉。

en.t: Japanese battleship Musashi is sunk in the Sibuyan Sea
en.s: On October 24, 1944, U.S. carrier aircraft sank the Japanese battleship Musashi in the Sibuyan Sea in the Philippines during the Battle of Leyte Gulf. Repeated bomb and torpedo attacks overwhelmed the Yamato-class ship. Many of its crew died, while others were rescued by accompanying ships.
en.n: Musashi sank on October 24, 1944, during the Battle of the Sibuyan Sea.

zh.t: 日本“武藏”号战列舰在锡布延海被击沉
zh.s: 1944年10月24日，在莱特湾海战期间，美军舰载机在菲律宾锡布延海击沉了日本“武藏”号战列舰。这艘大和级战列舰遭到多轮炸弹和鱼雷攻击后沉没，许多舰员丧生，另有一部分获附近舰艇救起。

en.t: The United Nations Charter enters into force
en.s: The Charter of the United Nations entered into force after the required ratifications had been deposited, formally bringing the organization into existence. Representatives had signed the document in San Francisco on June 26, following negotiations near the end of the Second World War. Entry into force required ratification by the five permanent members of the Security Council and a majority of the other signatories. The charter established institutions and principles intended to support international peace, cooperation, and human rights. October 24 became United Nations Day, distinguishing the organization's legal beginning from the earlier signing ceremony and its subsequent institutional development.
en.n: An international legal event; the geography identifies the treaty’s ratification depositary.

zh.s: 在必要的批准书存放后，《联合国宪章》正式生效，联合国由此正式成立。各国代表此前于第二次世界大战接近尾声时在旧金山谈判，并于6月26日签署文件。宪章生效需要安全理事会五个常任理事国及其他签署国过半数批准。宪章确立了旨在维护国际和平、合作和人权的机构及原则。10月24日后来成为联合国日，以此区别联合国的法律成立日期、此前的签署仪式及之后的机构发展。
zh.n: 这是一起国际法律事件；地点标注的是条约批准书的保存地。

en.s: United Air Lines Flight 608 was a Douglas DC-6 airliner, registration NC37510, on a scheduled passenger flight from Los Angeles to Chicago when it crashed at 12:29 pm on October 24, 1947, about 1.5 miles (2.4 km) southeast of Bryce Canyon Airport, Utah, United States. All five crew members and 47 passengers on board were killed.

zh.s: 联合航空608号班机是一架道格拉斯DC-6客机，注册编号NC37510，执行从洛杉矶飞往芝加哥的定期客运航班。1947年10月24日12时29分，飞机在美国犹他州布莱斯峡谷机场东南约1.5英里（2.4公里）处坠毁。机上5名机组人员和47名乘客全部遇难。

en.s: The Battle of Chamdo (or Qamdo; Chinese: 昌都战役) occurred from 6 to 24 October 1950. en.t: Northern Rhodesia becomes independent as Zambia
en.s: On October 24, 1964, Northern Rhodesia gained independence from Britain and became the Republic of Zambia. Kenneth Kaunda became the new republic's first president. The change followed the dissolution of the Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland at the end of 1963 and elections in 1964.

zh.t: 北罗得西亚独立，成为赞比亚共和国

en.s: The third round of full-dress talks between the North Korean and South Korean Red Cross societies opened in Pyongyang on 24 October 1972. The meetings continued through 26 October. The talks addressed families separated by the Korean War.

zh.t: 朝韩红十字会第三轮会谈在平壤举行
zh.s: 1972年10月24日，朝鲜红十字会与韩国红十字会在平壤开始第三轮正式会谈，会谈持续至10月26日，议题包括朝鲜战争造成的离散家属问题。
zh.n: 这一天是第三轮会谈的开幕日，并非双方首次举行红十字会会谈。

en.s: The 1977 United Nations Security Council election was held on 24 October 1977 during the Thirty-second session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. The General Assembly elected Bolivia, Czechoslovakia, Gabon, Kuwait, and Nigeria, as the five new non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for two-year mandates commencing on 1 January 1978.

zh.s: 1977年10月24日，联合国大会第32届会议期间，在纽约联合国总部举行安全理事会选举。大会选出玻利维亚、捷克斯洛伐克、加蓬、科威特和尼日利亚为安理会五个新任非常任理事国，任期两年，自1978年1月1日起开始。

en.s: The 1982 Norwegian Football Cup final was the 77th final of the Norwegian Football Cup. The final took place at Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo on 24 October 1982. SK Brann were in their 9th final (4 wins and 4 runners-up), while Molde were in their first ever final and therefore had the chance to win the first major trophy in the club's history.

zh.s: 1982年挪威足球杯决赛是第77届挪威足球杯决赛，于1982年10月24日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔体育场举行。布兰第9次闯入决赛，此前曾4次夺冠、4次获得亚军；莫尔德则首次进入决赛，有机会赢得俱乐部历史上的首个重要冠军。

en.s: The 1987 Louisiana gubernatorial election was held to elect the governor of Louisiana. Three-term incumbent Democratic governor Edwin Edwards withdrew from re-election to a fourth term, granting victory to Democratic congressman Buddy Roemer. Edwin Edwards defeated Governor Dave Treen in the 1983 election. Edwards was prosecuted as governor by U.S. District Attorney John Volz for selling hospital certificates, but the first trial results in a hung jury before Edwards was acquitted. Under Louisiana's jungle primary system, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party, and voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. On October 24, 1987, Roemer and Edwards took the two highest popular vote counts.

zh.s: 路易斯安那州举行州长选举，选出州长。已任职三届的民主党州长埃德温·爱德华兹退出竞选，民主党国会议员巴迪·罗默因此胜出。爱德华兹曾在1983年选举中击败州长戴夫·特里恩。爱德华兹任州长期间曾因出售医院证书受到美国联邦地区检察官约翰·沃尔兹起诉；首轮审理中陪审团未能达成一致，之后爱德华兹被宣告无罪。根据路易斯安那州丛林初选制度，所有候选人不分党派列在同一张选票上，选民可以投给任何候选人。1987年10月24日，罗默和爱德华兹获得最高的普选票数。

en.s: The 1987 Louisiana lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 21, 1987, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Louisiana. Former Republican Secretary of State of Louisiana Paul Hardy defeated incumbent Democratic lieutenant governor Robert Louis Freeman Sr. in the Runoff election, thereby becoming the first Republican to have been elected lieutenant governor of the U.S. state of Louisiana since Reconstruction.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 1987年路易斯安那州副州长选举
zh.s: 1987年路易斯安那州副州长选举于1987年11月21日举行，旨在选出该州副州长。共和党前州务卿保罗·哈代在第二轮选举中击败民主党籍时任副州长罗伯特·路易斯·弗里曼父子，自重建时期以来首次有共和党人当选路易斯安那州副州长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.s: The Pakistan General elections, 1990 took place on 24 October 1990 to elect 217 MPs to the Pakistan Parliament, and resulted in surprise victory of Islamic Democratic Alliance (IDA), a massive conservative front led under the leadership of Nawaz Sharif. The IDA compete for the Prime minister secretariat and initially campaign on privatisation and national conservative polices, meanwhile the MQM, a liberal front, led under Altaf Hussain tightened its support in Sindh Province. The result was a victory for Islami Jamhoori Ittehad, which won 106 of the 207 seats. Voter turnout was 45.5%.

zh.s: 巴基斯坦于1990年10月24日举行大选，选出国会议员217名。结果出乎预料，纳瓦兹·谢里夫领导的大型保守派阵线伊斯兰民主联盟（IDA）获胜。该联盟竞选总理职位，竞选重点是私有化和保守民族主义政策；自由派政党穆塔希达·考米运动（MQM）由阿尔塔夫·侯赛因领导，在信德省巩固了支持。最终，伊斯兰民主联盟赢得207个席位中的106席。投票率为45.5%。

en.s: General elections were held in Islamabad Capital Territory on Wednesday, 24 October 1990 to elect 1 member of National Assembly of Pakistan from Islamabad. Pakistan Muslim League (N) won Islamabad seat by the margin of 13,328 votes.

zh.t: 1990年巴基斯坦大选伊斯兰堡选区选举
zh.s: 巴基斯坦伊斯兰堡首都区于1990年10月24日星期三举行大选，选出一名国民议会议员。巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟（谢里夫派）以13,328票的多数优势赢得伊斯兰堡席位。

en.t: China Qiyuan is established in Beijing
en.s: China Qiyuan was established in Beijing on 24 October 1991 under the State Physical Culture and Sports Commission. It oversaw Go, xiangqi and international chess. Chen Zude became its first president.
en.n: This marks its establishment in October 1991, rather than the separate March 1992 inauguration date.

zh.s: 1991年10月24日，中国棋院在北京成立，隶属国家体委，负责围棋、中国象棋和国际象棋等项目。陈祖德出任首任院长。
zh.n: 这是中国棋院于1991年10月成立的日期；1992年3月另举行了成立大会。

en.t: Jiang Zemin meets Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko in Beijing
en.s: Jiang Zemin, then general secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, met Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing on 24 October 1992. The meeting took place during the Japanese imperial couple's official visit to China.
en.n: Jiang was party general secretary at this meeting; he became president of China in March 1993.

zh.t: 江泽民在北京会见明仁天皇和美智子皇后
zh.s: 1992年10月24日，时任中共中央总书记的江泽民在北京钓鱼台国宾馆会见明仁天皇和美智子皇后。当时，日本皇室夫妇正在中国进行正式访问。
zh.n: 会见时江泽民任中共中央总书记；他于1993年3月出任国家主席。

en.s: The 1993 Scottish League Cup final was played on 24 October 1993, at Celtic Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 48th Scottish League Cup competition. The final was contested by Rangers and Hibernian. Rangers won the match 2–1 thanks to goals by Ian Durrant and Ally McCoist.

zh.s: 1993年苏格兰联赛杯决赛于1993年10月24日在格拉斯哥凯尔特人公园举行，是第48届苏格兰联赛杯决赛。流浪者对阵希伯尼安，凭伊恩·杜兰特和阿利·麦考伊斯特的进球，以2比1获胜。

en.s: The 1993 Halloween Havoc was the fifth annual Halloween Havoc professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on October 24, 1993, from the Lakefront Arena in New Orleans, Louisiana. Eight matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Vader defeated Cactus Jack in a Texas Death match.

zh.s: 1993年万圣节浩劫是世界冠军摔角（WCW）举办的第五届年度职业摔角付费赛事，于1993年10月24日在路易斯安那州新奥尔良的湖滨竞技场举行。赛事共进行了8场比赛。主赛中，维德在一场德州死亡赛中击败仙人掌杰克。

en.s: The 1993 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 1993 Norwegian Football Cup, the 88th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 24 October 1993 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and was contested between the Tippeligaen side Bodø/Glimt and the First Division side Strømsgodset.

zh.s: 1993年挪威足球杯决赛是第88届挪威足球杯赛事的决赛，由挪威足球协会（NFF）主办，是挪威顶级足球杯赛。比赛于1993年10月24日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔体育场举行，对阵双方是挪威顶级联赛球队博德闪耀和甲级联赛球队斯托姆加斯特。

en.s: The 1994 Grand Prix de Tennis de Lyon was a tennis tournament played on indoor carpet courts at the Palais des Sports de Gerland in Lyon in France and was part of the World Series of the 1994 ATP Tour. The tournament ran from October 17 through October 24, 1994.

zh.s: 1994年里昂网球大奖赛在法国里昂热尔兰体育宫的室内地毯球场举行，是1994年ATP巡回赛世界系列赛的一站。赛事于1994年10月17日至24日举行。

en.s: The First Congo War, also known as Africa's First World War, was a civil and international military conflict that lasted from 24 October 1996 to 16 May 1997, primarily taking place in Zaire (which was renamed the Democratic Republic of the Congo during the conflict). The war resulted in the overthrow of Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, who was replaced by rebel leader Laurent-Désiré Kabila.

zh.s: 第一次刚果战争又称“非洲第一次世界大战”，是一场内战兼国际军事冲突，持续时间为1996年10月24日至1997年5月16日，主要发生在扎伊尔（战争期间更名为刚果民主共和国）。战争推翻了扎伊尔总统蒙博托·塞塞·塞科，由反叛军领导人洛朗-德西雷·卡比拉接任。

en.t: Deep Space 1 is launched to explore the asteroid belt and test new spacecraft technologies
en.s: Deep Space 1 (DS1) was a NASA technology demonstration spacecraft which flew by an asteroid and a comet. It was part of the New Millennium Program, dedicated to testing advanced technologies. Launched on 24 October 1998, the Deep Space 1 spacecraft carried out a flyby of asteroid 9969 Braille, which was its primary science target. The mission was extended twice to include an encounter with comet 19P/Borrelly and further engineering testing.

zh.t: 深空1号发射升空，探索小行星带并测试新型航天技术
zh.s: 深空1号是一艘美国国家航空航天局的技术验证飞船，曾飞掠一颗小行星和一颗彗星。它隶属新千年计划，任务是测试先进技术。深空1号于1998年10月24日发射，随后飞掠其主要科学目标——小行星9969布莱尔。任务两度延期，以便探访19P/博雷利彗星并继续进行工程测试。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Kazakhstan on 10 October 1999, with a second round on 24 October. The result was a victory for the new Otan party (which backed dictator Nursultan Nazarbayev), which won 23 of the 77 seats. Voter turnout was 62.5%. The main opposition party, Azamat, was not on the ballot. International monitors expressed concerns about the conduct of the elections.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 哈萨克斯坦于1999年10月10日举行议会选举，第二轮于10月24日举行。新成立的祖国党获胜，该党支持总统努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫，赢得77个席位中的23席。投票率为62.5%。主要反对党阿扎马特党未列入选票。国际观察员对选举过程表示担忧。

en.t: Chile and South Korea conclude free-trade negotiations
en.s: Chile and South Korea reached agreement on the remaining issues in their free-trade negotiations on 24 October 2002. The negotiating round ran from 18 to 24 October. The text still needed to be finalized and formally signed.
en.n: This records the conclusion of negotiations, not the later signature or entry into force of the agreement. Both countries are indexed as parties, not as two physical meeting venues.

zh.t: 智利与韩国结束自由贸易谈判
zh.s: 2002年10月24日，智利与韩国就自由贸易谈判中的剩余议题达成一致。本轮谈判于10月18日至24日举行，协议文本仍待定稿和正式签署。
zh.n: 此处记录的是谈判结束，并非协议后来的签署或生效日期。智利和韩国是协议双方，不代表两个实际会谈地点。

en.s: The 2003 Ms. Olympia contest is an IFBB professional bodybuilding competition and part of Joe Weider's Olympia Fitness & Performance Weekend 2003 was held on October 24, 2003, at the Mandalay Bay Arena in Paradise, Nevada. It was the 24th Ms. Olympia competition held. Other events at the exhibition include the Mr. Olympia, Fitness Olympia, and Figure Olympia contests.

zh.s: 2003年奥林匹亚女士大赛是国际健美联合会职业健美比赛，也是2003年乔·韦德奥林匹亚健身与表演周的一部分，于2003年10月24日在内华达州天堂市曼德勒海湾体育馆举行。这是第24届奥林匹亚女士大赛。展会的其他项目包括奥林匹亚先生、健身奥林匹亚和形体奥林匹亚比赛。

en.s: W.A.K.O. European Championships 2004 in Budva were the joint seventeenth European championships (the other event would be held the next month in Maribor, Slovenia) and were the fourth W.A.K.O. championships (including world) to be held in Serbia and Montenegro/Yugoslavia. The event was open to around 300 amateur men and women from 26 nations from across Europe. The styles on offer at Budva included; Full-Contact, Low-Kick and Thai-Boxing – with women's Thai-Boxing competitions introduced for the very first time at a W.A.K.O. championships. The other less physical competitions (Light and Semi-Contact, Musical Forms, Aero Kickboxing) would take place at the event in Maribor.

zh.s: 2004年W.A.K.O.欧洲锦标赛在布德瓦举行，是当年第17届欧洲锦标赛中的一场；另一场将于次月在斯洛文尼亚马里博尔举行。这也是塞尔维亚和黑山／南斯拉夫举办的第四届W.A.K.O.锦标赛（含世界锦标赛）。赛事面向来自欧洲26个国家的约300名业余男女选手。布德瓦站设全接触、低踢和泰拳项目，女子泰拳比赛首次列入W.A.K.O.锦标赛。较少身体接触的轻接触、半接触、音乐套路和有氧跆拳道项目则将在马里博尔举行。

en.t: Saint Kitts and Nevis general election, 2004
en.s: General elections were held in Saint Kitts and Nevis on 24 October 2004. They were won by the Saint Kitts and Nevis Labour Party, who took over 50% of the vote and seven of the eleven elected seats in the National Assembly.

zh.s: 圣基茨和尼维斯于2004年10月24日举行大选。圣基茨和尼维斯工党获胜，得票率超过50%，并赢得国民议会11个民选席位中的7席。

en.s: The "Battle of the Buffet", also known as "Pizzagate", was a Premier League match played between Manchester United and Arsenal at Old Trafford, Manchester, on 24 October 2004. Arsenal dictated much of the early play and created several openings, but as the game progressed Manchester United threatened. The home team were awarded a penalty in the 73rd minute, when Wayne Rooney was deemed to have been fouled by Sol Campbell.

zh.s: “自助餐之战”又称“披萨门”，是曼彻斯特联队和阿森纳于2004年10月24日在曼彻斯特老特拉福德球场进行的一场英超比赛。阿森纳在比赛初期掌控大部分攻势并创造多次机会，但随着比赛推进，曼联开始形成威胁。第73分钟，裁判判定韦恩·鲁尼被索尔·坎贝尔犯规，主队因此获得点球。

en.s: The 2004 FAI Cup final was the deciding match of the 2004 FAI Cup. Defending champions Longford Town contested the final against Waterford United. The match was played at Lansdowne Road in Dublin. Longford won the match 2–1.

zh.s: 2004年爱尔兰足协杯决赛决定了当年爱尔兰足协杯冠军归属。卫冕冠军朗福德镇队与沃特福德联队争夺冠军。比赛在都柏林兰斯当路球场举行，朗福德镇队以2比1获胜。

en.t: East Tsim Sha Tsui station opens in Hong Kong
en.s: On October 24, 2004, East Tsim Sha Tsui station opened as the southern end of the Kowloon–Canton Railway's East Rail extension from Hung Hom. The extension returned the railway to the Tsim Sha Tsui area after thirty years. The underground station connected with Tsim Sha Tsui station through pedestrian passageways.
en.n: This is the station's 2004 opening as an East Rail terminus, before later changes to its rail service.

zh.s: 2004年10月24日，尖东站随九广东铁由红磡向南延伸而启用，成为当时东铁的南端总站。这条延线让铁路时隔30年重返尖沙咀一带。位于地下的尖东站通过行人通道与尖沙咀站相连。

en.t: Chang'e 1, the first satellite in the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program, is launched from Xichang Satellite Launch Center
en.s: Chang'e 1 ( ; simplified Chinese: 嫦娥一号; traditional Chinese: 嫦娥一號; pinyin: Cháng'é yī hào) was an uncrewed Chinese lunar-orbiting spacecraft, part of the first phase of the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program. The spacecraft was named after the Chinese Moon goddess, Chang'e. Chang'e 1 was launched on 24 October 2007 at 10:05:04 UTC from Xichang Satellite Launch Center. It left lunar transfer orbit on 31 October and entered lunar orbit on 5 November.

zh.t: 嫦娥一号发射升空，开启中国月球探测计划
zh.s: 嫦娥一号是中国首阶段月球探测计划的一艘无人月球轨道飞行器，以中国神话中的月神嫦娥命名。嫦娥一号于2007年10月24日世界协调时10时05分04秒从西昌卫星发射中心发射升空。它于10月31日离开地月转移轨道，并于11月5日进入月球轨道。

en.t: AAA stages the second Antonio Peña Memorial Show in Veracruz
en.s: On October 24, 2008, the Mexican wrestling promotion AAA held its second Antonio Peña Memorial Show in Veracruz, Mexico. The event honored the company’s late founder. Its card included the Antonio Peña Cup tournament, won by El Mesías, and a cage-match main event.

zh.s: 2008年10月24日，墨西哥职业摔角联盟AAA在韦拉克鲁斯举办第二届安东尼奥·佩尼亚纪念赛，纪念已故创始人。赛事包括由埃尔·梅西亚斯夺冠的安东尼奥·佩尼亚杯，以及作为压轴赛的铁笼赛。

en.s: The Louisiana lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on October 24, 2015, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Louisiana, with a runoff election held on November 21, 2015. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Jay Dardenne did not for re-election to a second full term in office. He instead ran for Governor. Billy Nungesser won the election defeating Kip Holden. Under Louisiana's jungle primary system, all candidates will appear on the same ballot, regardless of party and voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation. en.s: On October 24, 2015, a vehicle-ramming attack took place during a parade in Stillwater, Oklahoma, United States. en.s: The 2025 Irish presidential election took place on Friday, 24 October 2025, to elect a new president of Ireland. The incumbent president, Michael D. Higgins, was term-limited, having served the maximum two seven-year terms permitted under the Constitution of Ireland. The nominated candidates were Catherine Connolly (independent), Jim Gavin (Fianna Fáil), and Heather Humphreys (Fine Gael). All three were nominated by members of the Oireachtas rather than by county or city councils.
